messages:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout: recommendation-service v4.0.0-beta -> 5% traffic us-west-2. change-window 2026-03-22 02:00-03:00 UTC. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/recommendation/4.0.0-beta

maya: eyeballing metrics — small p95 bump and a few 504s from the model proxy. p95 420ms (baseline 130ms).

raj: seeing a pattern: backend pool exhaustion on a single host due to longer tail from cold KV cache misses. Could be the new prefetch in beta.

sam: can we soft-stop and pin the staged cohort back to v3.9.4 while we validate? Don't want to escalate to a full rollback yet.

ops-bot: Alert: recommendation-service us-west-2 error-rate > 0.5% (policy=SR-5xx). Automated gating suggests manual review.

maya: agree pin. raj, can you issue the pin and confirm traffic shift?

raj: issuing pin now: `/release pause service=recommendation-service cohort=staged version=v3.9.4 reason="504 spike during beta"`

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 5%. Cohort pinned to v3.9.4. action=rl-4850001234-pause

ops-bot: Routing update complete. Telemetry backfill ~40s.

maya: 5xx rate dropping back to baseline after pin. p95 returning to ~140ms. Good rollback signal.

sam: next steps: 1) raj to collect heap and connection stats from the affected host; 2) disable prefetch in beta build; 3) plan micro-canary (1%) behind flag after fix.

raj: taking trace/host triage. Will post findings in 25m. If it's the prefetch, patch + patch release then small probe.

oncall: watching the window. Will escalate if any noise reappears.

maya: thanks all. I'll update the release notes and add an addendum to the change-window. Staying on this thread.
